The villains of the Elvenbane fortress, west of Ab'Dendriel, have a crystal ball they use to spy on the elves' war talks. {npc:Eroth} gives you a {item:Mirror} to reflect the ball's power and destroy it. You climb to the top of the central Elvenbane tower, use the mirror on the {item:Scrying Ball} and receive 10 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and an {item:Elven Amulet}.
The elves need your help in a war against the villains of the surrounding area.
The central tower of Elvenbane is full of assorted monsters (even a {creature:Dragon} and {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}). Bring potions and do not pull too many at once.

Go to **Ab'Dendriel**. At the depot, go up **one floor** and head **west**. Tell {npc:Eroth}: {key:hi}, {key:mission}, {key:yes}. He gives you a {item:Mirror} to destroy the crystal ball on top of Elvenbane.
2. Destroy the Scrying Ball in Elvenbane

Leave through the gate of **Ab'Dendriel** and head **south**, then **west** and then **north** to the {wiki:Elvenbane Fortress}, which is on an island west of the city. You can only get in through an underground cave: go down the hole surrounded by **four stones** at the entrance. In the basement, run **north** and then **west** to the opening and go around to the **central tower**. At the entrance you will need a {item:Destroy Field Rune}.

The castle corridors are so narrow that only one person can pass at a time: watch out for anyone blocking your way when an {creature:Orc Berserker} or a {creature:Minotaur Guard} is coming up behind you.
Enter the **central tower** and climb to the **top floor**.

You will find lots of monsters: {creature:Troll|Trolls}, {creature:Orc|Orcs}, {creature:Orc Warrior|Orc Warriors}, {creature:Orc Berserker|Orc Berserkers}, {creature:Orc Shaman|Orc Shamans}, {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves}, {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}, {creature:Minotaur Guard|Minotaur Guards}, {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages}, {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons} and a {creature:Dragon}.
At the top of the tower, use the {item:Mirror} on the {item:Scrying Ball}.

Go back the same way: go down the central tower by the same stairs, cross the basement back (**east** and then **south**) to the hole you fell through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up. Then return to Ab'Dendriel (south, east and north to the gate) to talk to Eroth.
Go back to {npc:Eroth} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}.
